title: T-Mobile Logo
slide_intent: Distinguish a full name from a compact symbol so a viewer receives enough context to identify the sender.
strategic_value: A clear hierarchy of full logo and T-Digit versions can keep T-Mobile recognizable across backgrounds and owned properties.
demonstration: Preferred magenta-on-white marks appear above inverse, black-background and monochrome variants.
practical_value: Select the full logo by default and choose a colorway suited to the background and viewing size.

content_islands.name: Usage explanation
content_islands.spec: Keep full-logo preference and access note in the left column.

content_islands.name: Primary marks
content_islands.spec: Show full logo and T-Digit side by side above their magenta and black background variants.

content_islands.name: Secondary marks
content_islands.spec: Place monochrome options in a bottom row with labels.

ingredient.name: Full logo and T-Digit
ingredient.role: Identify the sender with either its name or a familiar compact symbol.
ingredient.application: Prefer magenta on white or white on magenta; use the full logo as primary. Check small magenta-on-black applications for vibration.
ingredient.scope: The T-Digit may replace the full logo on owned properties such as web and retail.
